summary: The live synthetic preview is readable at 320×844, 390×844, 600×844, 900×844, and 1280×844, with no visible clipping. Spacing, restrained borders, status hierarchy, Korean conversation copy, and the inert link preview are sound. Source inspection shows loading, error, and malformed-result fallbacks. One static interface label and the browser title remain in English despite the Korean UI contract.

open_findings.finding: “LOCAL WORKBENCH” and “Workbench · Synthetic preview” are static English interface labels. Localize them for the Korean UI. The fixture workspace name “Demo project” is sample data and is outside this finding.

limits: Live review used a synthetic fixture. Loading, error, and malformed-result states were inspected in source and existing test coverage, not reproduced visually in this review. Real SDK streaming, permission flows, dark mode, 200% zoom, and screen-reader output were not tested. The requested gpt-6-sol/high route and runtime identity were not independently verified.
